# Pull Request

## Description

A brief description of what this PR does and the problem it solves.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Breaking change (`feat!:`)
- [ ] Documentation update (`docs:`)
- [ ] Refactoring / Chore (`refactor:` / `chore:`)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project conventions in `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I have written tests covering my changes (where applicable).
- [ ] All Go tests pass (`go test ./...`).
- [ ] All linters pass (`npm run lint` or `.\lint.ps1`).
- [ ] Documentation has been updated (if applicable).
